text: Hey guys, this is part 2 of the video where I translate what women say. Situation 1. Imagine you text a girl. She opens your message but does not reply, or in other words, she leaves you on read. Translation. I saw your message, but I don't really care about you, so I would not even bother replying. What to do? Don't text second time. Move on. You are not a backup plan. Situation 2. You text a girl, but she does not reply for a really long time, for example, many hours or even days. And then she texts, sorry, I didn't see your message. Translation. I saw your message, but I ignored it, because you are not that important to me. And now I decided to be more polite and text you that I did not see it. What to do? Go, Olin. One last shot. Invite her out. If she flakes again, you are done. Move on. Situation 3. Imagine you know this girl, and you actually like her. And suddenly, out of the blue, she texts you something. For example, what are you doing? Or what are your plans for the weekend? Translation. I am interested in you, but I am a girl, so I do not want to be too direct. What to do? Well, you have a green light. You ask her out. And if you do everything correctly, you should have a good time with her.
